name: Laws of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
label: Taiwan
history: versions for some laws, current text for others
record_note: Current text from law.moj.gov.tw. Past versions of the laws in the README’s "Past versions" table (6) from 立法院法律系統 (lis.ly.gov.tw), appended as one block per law and dated by the commencement day the record states or the third day after promulgation (中央法規標準法 §13). Other laws have one version, dated by the page date (not a commencement day).

dates.commit: page date (修正日期 or 公布日期) of the current text
dates.history_commits: In-force = 施行 day stated by 立法院法律系統, else promulgation + 2 days (中央法規標準法 §13); commit date = the day the block was appended

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: non-retroactivity of laws (法律不溯及既往原則)
default_reach.meaning: a law governs facts arising after it takes effect unless it says otherwise; in criminal law the law at the time of the act applies unless a later law is more favourable to the offender
default_reach.authority: 中央法規標準法 §13, §18; 中華民國刑法 §1, §2; 司法院釋字第525號、第574號 (protection of reliance)

history_sources.name: 立法院法律系統 (Legislative Yuan)
